validates.rationale: The §3 failure-semantics clause makes the previously-undecided running-system behavior explicit — primary halts create-path writes (fail-closed on durability, RPO=0 preserved), rejects silent async-degrade, emits a degraded-mode signal returning a bounded error tied to BDD.01.03.1f90, with read-path independence backed by §7 pool isolation and a §5 cross-service blast-radius risk entry.
